== Summary ==
Known to his many fans as Nog on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, [[Aron Eisenberg]] signed a thousand collectibles during his sessions with Decipher fans. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Guests|guests at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
